name: Toolbox: Toolbelt, HUDs, Trackers and more.
description: The Toolbelt: your buffs, debuffs, health, focus, Vigor, food, potions, worn-out gear and your target in one movable strip you can show only in combat, with a sound and red flash before a buff runs out. Plus XP per hour and time to level, everything looted, crafted and gathered today with market values, DPS and combat stats, and notifications. Open it with /toolbox or Ctrl+;.
author: shawn butts
